structure_title: Each defined micro-worker is the head of exactly one 666-role specialized branch
one_parent_reporting: New H-role reports ONLY to its G-role boss; G reports to S; S to W; W to M; M to D; D to OWNER. 2 independent director assistants remain reporting only to D.
unique_assignment_slots: 18 sectors × 37 methods = 666 individual mission combinations per branch; sector=(slot-1)//37; method=(slot-1)%37

activation.method: lazy deterministic role identifiers; do not create files or accounts for 374,625,000,000 identities
activation.bounded_inference: When a G parent has actually completed its own open-weight model inference, attempt at most one rotated H-role independent inference for that active parent on that cycle, subject to available runner resources
activation.no_genuine_recruitment_claim: Configured roles are not separate external social identities, human hires or hosted model services. Only successful independent AI calls documented in GitHub research artifacts can be called executed.
activation.non_disruptive: No 374.625-billion simultaneous API lookups, external messages, job applications, or wallet requests. Existing real search and payout verification remain prioritized.
activation.rotation: Use deterministic per-parent varied slot that advances per cycle so more assignments can eventually be sampled; not all will be run.

mission: ALL 374,625,000,000 deterministically defined H-role identities inherit OWNER DIRECTIVE ORD-021: for each role that is actually activated, independently research WORLDWIDE for genuine lawful paid tasks and projects feasible to complete and settle in real transferable cryptocurrency, aiming at verified deposits into existing owner-approved correct-network addresses. Seek opportunities across disciplines, check original payer, work and acceptance terms, amount, applicant eligibility, authenticity, no upfront fees, available authorized outreach and matching payment routes. H roles report only to their G parent; research leads, posts and configured IDs never count as payments. Confirm deposits independently; do not claim roles have run unless evidence proves completed model inference.
privacy: Anonymous mission only; never reveal private owner data, keys, credentials, full wallet maps or custodial exchange memos.
tool_improvement_order: ORD-022: Every activated LAST H worker independently assesses helpful additional sites, tools, public APIs, AI model resources, research and paid-work platforms WORLDWIDE. Distinguish source discovery, actual permitted API usage, credentials/fees needed, and objectively better legitimate crypto-paying work outcomes. Report to one G parent, never claim installed tools or successful payments without evidence.
independent_after_owner_order: ORD-023: Every activated FINAL H branch worker independently researches worldwide, uses permitted read-only tools, investigates earning opportunities, checks payer and coins/receiving chain, challenges weak sources, and reports facts to its G parent without repeated prompts. A defined role ID is NOT an executing AI worker until an actual successful model/tool run is evidenced.
